candidates.title: MoE-GPS: Guidlines for Prediction Strategy for Dynamic Expert Duplication in MoE Load Balancing
candidates.reason: Systems study of prediction strategy for dynamic expert duplication/load balancing; reports >23% end-to-end inference improvement on Mixtral 8x7B.

candidates.title: MoE-Beyond: Learning-Based Expert Activation Prediction on Edge Devices
candidates.reason: Learning-based expert activation prediction for cache/prefetch on memory-constrained edge devices; improves simulated GPU expert-cache hit rate from 17% to 72% at 10% residency.

candidates.title: STEP: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Expert Prefetching for Low-Latency and Memory-Efficient MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Direct MoE inference framework combining layer-wise expert allocation, predictive prefetch and token-aware windows; reports up to 3.12x speedup under constrained memory.

candidates.title: MoE-APEX: An Efficient MoE Inference System with Adaptive Precision Expert Offloading
candidates.reason: Llama.cpp-based MoE offloading system combining adaptive precision, expert prefetch and cost-aware caching; reports 1.34x–9.75x decoding speedups across edge devices.

candidates.title: Two-Stage Expert Offloading for Domain-Aware MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Domain-aware prefill preload plus locality-aware decode prefetch for MoE expert offloading; reports 50% lower I/O wait, 3.45x speedup and 33% lower peak memory.
